thread:
mia_sales: Solstice POC seeing sporadic 429s and slow first-byte/first-token on demo traffic. Procurement wants a fix today. Can infra swarm?

owen_sales: They're asking if a short Dedicated slot is the right move or if config tuning will be enough. Need a quick remediation path + price.

keera_devex: I'll triage. Paste one failing request and the recent metrics window (batch sizes, prefill flag, kv hit rate).

ivan_infra: Pulled traces. Quick snapshot: many single-request batches, low KV hits, client explicitly disabling prefill.

ivan_infra: metrics: 
route: solstice-poc
first_token_ms_p95: 1320
median_token_ms: 54
batch_size_avg: 1.1
prefill_header: false
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.11
429_1h: 38

pat_support: 429s are `shard-queue-full` from the front proxy in us-west-2. Tiny batches are amplifying queue pressure.

lee_ml: With prefill off we recompute long prefixes from their ~650-token system prompt. That explains high first-token latency.

mia_sales: They disabled prefill over cost concerns. Procurement wants a one-liner about token impact.

ivan_infra: Short-term plan: 1) route to a quieter dedicated shard for a 6h smoke, 2) enable server-side prefill override for the POC, 3) bump batch window to 10ms, 4) temporary quota bump.

keera_devex: Also recommend SDK sample defaults set prefill:auto for POC templates and a small docs note on token tradeoffs. I'll make a PR.

ivan_infra: Applying route override: shard=us-west-2-dedicated-smoke, batch_window_ms=10, prefill_override=enable, kv_cache_quota=10GB.

deploy-bot: [deploy] route override applied to `solstice-poc` by ivan_infra @ 2025-10-11T08:12:07Z :sparkles:

ivan_infra: After changes and quota bump: 
first_token_ms_p95: 360
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.69
batch_size_avg: 3.3
429_1h: 1

mia_sales: Great improvement. Can we capture numbers + a procurement blurb? They asked price for a 6h Dedicated transient.

own_sales: Finance suggested $185 for a 6h transient slot + normal usage. I'll confirm if they need a PO.

lee_ml: Blurb: "Enabling prefill may send warm prefixes (token delta ~5-9%) but reduces compute and throttling by reusing KV cache, typically lowering overall POC cost while improving latency."

pat_support: Uploaded raw logs to s3://redwood-ops/pocs/solstice/1799990000/logs.tar.gz and will keep monitoring.

ivan_infra: Dedicated-smoke is configured to forward audit logs to customer KMS scope; will send proof. Leaving override for 6h and then revert unless they ask otherwise.

mia_sales: Next steps: keera PR to change SDK examples, ivan send audit proof, owen send pricing + before/after metrics to Solstice. I'll run the follow-up call tomorrow 09:00. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

pat_support: Will reopen if 429s reappear.

end of thread
